name: STAR Orbit — secular J2 rates, sun-synchronous and critical inclination
summary: First-order secular effect of J2 on mean elements: node regression, perigee rotation, mean-anomaly rate, nodal period, sun-synchronous inclination; measured within 0.4 % of Orekit's Eckstein-Hechler theory and of a numerical integration.
reference: Textbook figures (Vallado, Fundamentals of Astrodynamics; Wertz, SMAD): critical inclination 63.4349 deg; ISS node regression about 5 deg/day; sun-synchronous inclination about 98.6 deg at 800 km and 97.4 deg at 500 km
reference_observed: critical inclination 63.43494882 deg; ISS-like orbit -5.0023 deg/day; 98.603 deg at 800 km; 97.402 deg at 500 km
